jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.context: Self-serve analytics platform for mid-market retailers
jobs.stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Kafka

bullets.text: Cut dashboard load time by 60% by moving report queries from on-request SQL to pre-aggregated PostgreSQL tables refreshed from Kafka events.
Own technical design and delivery of the reporting product used by 400+ retail customers, from discovery through launch, building React frontends and Node.js services on PostgreSQL.
Lead a team of 5 engineers through system design, code review and mentoring; introduced design docs and a weekly architecture review.
Reduced support tickets by 30% by shipping an in-product assistant that answers metric questions with RAG over the docs and the customer's own schema, with evals run on every release.
Re-architected the API as multi-tenant SaaS with row-level security and RBAC, unblocking the first enterprise contracts.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.context: Freight tracking software for regional carriers
jobs.stack: Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS

bullets.text: Built a real-time shipment tracking service in Python and FastAPI that processes 2M GPS events a day and pushes updates to dispatchers over WebSockets.
Saved dispatchers 10 hours a week by replacing spreadsheet imports with a validated ETL pipeline and a React review screen.
Set up Docker builds and GitHub Actions CI/CD with Jest and Playwright tests, taking releases from monthly to weekly.
Built internal admin tools in Node.js and Express.js on MongoDB for the operations team.

projects.title: MetricsBot | Open-source Slack bot · 2023
bullets: Built a Slack bot in TypeScript that answers plain-English questions about a PostgreSQL warehouse using OpenAI tool calling and a read-only SQL sandbox.

projects.title: Trip Planner | Weekend project · 2022
bullets: Built a Next.js trip planner with a Redis cache and a GraphQL API over public transit data.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science · 2017

FullStack.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer · TypeScript · React · Node.js · Python
FullStack.summary: Senior full-stack software engineer with 7 years of experience building data-heavy web products with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and Python (FastAPI) on PostgreSQL, Redis and AWS. Designs REST and GraphQL APIs, event-driven pipelines on Kafka and multi-tenant SaaS. Leads small teams through design and code review and ships LLM features (RAG, evals) in production.

Backend.headline: Senior Backend Software Engineer · Node.js · Python · PostgreSQL · Kafka
Backend.summary: Senior backend software engineer with 7 years of experience designing APIs and data pipelines in Node.js, TypeScript and Python (FastAPI) on PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka, deployed on AWS with Docker. Builds event-driven and multi-tenant SaaS systems, tunes slow queries and owns services from design to on-call. Leads small teams through design and code review.

AI_Engineer.headline: Software Engineer, AI Products · LLM Features & RAG · TypeScript & Python
AI_Engineer.summary: Software engineer with 7 years of production experience, including shipping LLM features end to end: RAG over customer data, OpenAI tool calling and evals on every release, built in TypeScript (Node.js, React) and Python (FastAPI). Shipped an in-product assistant that reduced support tickets by 30% at a Series B analytics company. Works across the stack on PostgreSQL, Redis and AWS.
